items.stem: May a driver pass on a two-lane road near a hill or curve that blocks the view of hazardous oncoming traffic?

options.text: No
options.rationale: Option A is correct. Do not pass on a two-lane road at or near a hill, curve or obstruction that blocks the view of potentially hazardous oncoming vehicles.

options.text: Yes, if the vehicle ahead is slow
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Do not pass on a two-lane road at or near a hill, curve or obstruction that blocks the view of potentially hazardous oncoming vehicles.

options.text: Yes, if the driver sounds the horn
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Do not pass on a two-lane road at or near a hill, curve or obstruction that blocks the view of potentially hazardous oncoming vehicles.

options.text: Yes, if the driver has passed there before
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Do not pass on a two-lane road at or near a hill, curve or obstruction that blocks the view of potentially hazardous oncoming vehicles.

items.correct_rationale: Option A is correct. Do not pass on a two-lane road at or near a hill, curve or obstruction that blocks the view of potentially hazardous oncoming vehicles.

items.stem: When securing a parked vehicle, how should the transmission be set?

options.text: Automatic in Neutral; manual in Neutral
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. For a parked vehicle with an automatic transmission, shift to Park; for a manual transmission, leave it in gear.

options.text: Both transmissions left in Neutral
